conventional.title: Conventional Loans — 3% Down for Qualified Buyers | KLE Mortgage

va.description: VA loans for veterans, active-duty, and eligible surviving spouses in Florida. 0% down, no PMI, competitive rates. Streamline IRRRL refinance available.

jumbo.title: Jumbo Loans Florida — Above $766,550 | KLE Mortgage
jumbo.description: Jumbo mortgages for Florida properties above the conforming limit. 10% down, competitive rates for strong credit profiles. Up to multi-million loan amounts.

refinance.title: Mortgage Refinance Florida — Lower Your Rate or Cash Out | KLE Mortgage
refinance.description: Refinance your Florida mortgage to lower your rate, shorten your term, or cash out equity. Rate-and-term, FHA Streamline, VA IRRRL, and cash-out options available.

first-time-buyer.title: First-Time Homebuyer Loans Florida | KLE Mortgage

WhyKLE.intro: We're not just a lender — we're your partner in one of the most important decisions of your life.
WhyKLE.promiseBody: At KLE Mortgage Financing, we believe homeownership changes lives. That's why we work tirelessly to find solutions that fit your budget, timeline, and goals.
WhyKLE.promisePoint1: No hidden fees or surprises at closing
WhyKLE.promisePoint3: Equal Housing Lender — we serve everyone
WhyKLE.benefit1Body: Get pre-approved in as little as 24 hours. We move quickly so you don't miss your dream home.
WhyKLE.benefit2Body: A dedicated loan officer guides you from application to closing — no call centers, no runaround.
WhyKLE.benefit3Body: We shop multiple lenders to secure the best rate for your situation, saving you thousands.
WhyKLE.benefit4Body: 15+ years of mortgage expertise. We explain every step in plain language so you always know where you stand.

fallback.1: KLE made our first home purchase stress-free. Our loan officer explained everything clearly and we closed in 28 days. Highly recommend!
fallback.2: As a veteran, I was grateful for the VA loan expertise at KLE. They knew exactly what I was entitled to and got me into my home with zero down.
fallback.3: I refinanced my home through KLE and saved $420/month. The process was seamless and my loan officer was always available to answer my questions.
fallback.4: We tried two other lenders before KLE — nobody could get our deal done. KLE found a program that worked perfectly for our situation.
fallback.5: As a single mom, I never thought homeownership was possible. KLE helped me qualify for a first-time buyer program and the whole team celebrated with me at closing!
fallback.6: We used USDA and got into our dream home in a great school district for 0% down. KLE walked us through every step. Cannot say enough good things.

AboutHero.intro: KLE Mortgage Financing was founded with one belief: every Florida family deserves a fair shot at homeownership. We bring expertise, transparency, and genuine care to every loan we close.

quotes.leopold-evariste: Every Florida family deserves a fair shot at homeownership. That's why I founded KLE — to make the mortgage process transparent and human.
quotes.joanne-evariste: Behind every smooth closing is a team that cares about the details. I make sure no document, deadline, or borrower question falls through the cracks.
quotes.jean-samuel-luxama: I walk with my clients from finding the home to securing the loan. One relationship, start to finish — same person from offer to closing.
quotes.olivier-desire: Complex loans don't scare me. DSCR for investors, USDA for the right neighborhoods — I find the right path for borrowers others give up on.
quotes.daniel-calixte: I believe in educating my clients. When you understand your VA or FHA options, you make better decisions and avoid costly mistakes.
quotes.carly-cadet: Buying a first home should feel exciting, not stressful. I bring the energy and the market knowledge so my clients always know what's next.

Mission.para1: KLE Mortgage Financing was founded by Leopold Evariste with a vision to bridge the homeownership gap in underserved Florida communities. We saw families who had the income to afford a home but lacked the guidance to navigate FHA, VA, USDA, and conventional mortgage programs.
Mission.para2: Today, we serve clients across Florida — from first-time buyers using the Hometown Heroes program to investors building portfolios with DSCR loans. Same white-glove service whether you're closing a $150,000 starter home or a $1.5M jumbo.
Mission.value1Body: Every decision we make is guided by what's best for the families we serve. We're not just closing mortgages — we're helping people build long-term wealth through homeownership.
Mission.value2Body: No hidden fees. No mortgage jargon. We explain every rate, every disclosure, and every option so you can make informed decisions about a 30-year commitment.
Mission.value3Body: Informed borrowers make better decisions. Whether it's first-time-buyer programs or DSCR investment financing, we take the time to teach what each option really means.
Mission.complianceEqualHousingValue: Equal Housing Lender. We comply with all fair lending laws.
